latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — discover and install agent skills to extend capabilities.

- Helps users find agent skills based on queries like "how do I do X" or "find a skill for X"
- Guides users on searching, choosing, and installing skills using the Skills CLI
- Suggests skill installation commands and provides links for more information
- Covers common skill categories and tips for effective searches
- Offers guidance when no relevant skills are found
